Introducing Club Boosters

Home » Introducing Club Boosters

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:24
Instaread

Big news, captains and club leaders! We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear: you want a way to accelerate your club’s growth and climb those leaderboards faster. Today, we are thrilled to announce our brand-new feature: the Club Booster.

If you’ve been looking for that extra “oomph” to get your club to the next level, this is the game-changer you’ve been waiting for.

What is the Club Booster?

The Club Booster is a powerful new item designed to supercharge your entire community. Once activated, it provides a massive surge to the Club Contribution (Club Experience) earned from every game played by your members.

In short: More games + Club Booster = A much faster level-up for your club!

How It Works

We’ve kept the process simple so you can focus on the gameplay:

  • Find the Booster: Navigate to the Clubs Menu and look for the shiny new Club Store tab.
  • Leader Exclusive: To ensure strategic coordination, the Club Booster can only be unlocked and activated by the Club Leader.
  • Total Transparency: Before a booster is acquired, all club members can see it waiting in the store. Once activated, everyone will see a status indicator showing that the boost is live.
  • Keep the Momentum Going: You can extend the duration of an active boost by activating another one, ensuring your XP gains never drop.

Why You’ll Love It

Leveling up your club isn’t just about the prestige – it’s about the perks, rewards, and status that come with being at the top. With the Club Booster, the grind becomes a sprint.

Whether you’re a new club trying to catch up or a veteran club defending your rank, this is your primary tool for dominance.

Note to Leaders: Head over to the Club Store today to obtain your booster and show your members what a true power-up looks like!

Climbing the Ranks: The Club Booster Strategy Guide

To help you get the absolute most out of this powerful new tool, we’ve compiled a few tips on how to coordinate its use for maximum impact:

1. Timing is Everything

Since the Club Booster multiplies contribution from all games played, activate it when your club is most active. If you usually have peak activity during weekend evenings, that’s your prime time. A boost during quiet hours is a missed opportunity.

2. Schedule “Boost Blitz” Events

Get your club chat buzzing! Announce a Boost Blitz (e.g., “Saturday Night at 8 PM – Boost is live!”). This creates excitement and encourages members to play more games, maximizing the boost effect.

3. Coordinate Extensions

If your club is having a high-activity session, extend the boost by activating another one. This keeps your XP multiplier running without interruption and maintains your momentum.

4. Push During Events

Use boosters during major in-game events or intense rivalries. This is when the advantage matters most and can help you dominate leaderboards and outperform competing clubs.

5. Open Communication is Key

Because only the Leader can activate the boost, communication is crucial. Leaders should inform members ahead of time, and members should coordinate group sessions so the boost can be used at the perfect moment.
